meta.question: on Aircraft K=29, does student-teacher map agreement rise with training with a switch point where student-only picking catches the teacher filter, and do gap tokens hurt through masked-teacher fidelity or through distance from the student?
meta.method: attention rollout (student late blocks, teacher all blocks); keep-only masked teacher faithfulness (KL, top-1 agreement); KD target distance KL(masked teacher || student); image bootstrap
meta.paper: Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (rollout); Hooker et al. NeurIPS 2019 (keep-only); Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD); Cho & Hariharan ICCV 2019 (capacity gap: student cannot follow a far target)
